protocol.source: Shared variable-direction/variable-goal off-policy replay; all 256 hidden units h.
protocol.decoder: Nested ridge: 4 whole-episode outer folds, 3 whole-episode inner folds. Training-only centering and one scalar feature scale. No unit-wise rescaling or PCA.
protocol.tuning: Mean squared coordinate error; direction predicts cos/sin and is scored by wrapped angular error.
protocol.baseline: Outer-training target mean; evaluated on the same held-out points.
protocol.goal_target: Actual remembered pickup position, not the physical goal center. Unknown-goal samples excluded only for this target.
protocol.limitation: Goal code is supplied externally to the LSTM. Goal decodability does not demonstrate internal memory storage, causal use, or behavioral benefit. Whole-episode holdout tests generalization to new sampled goals and rooms; it does not isolate direction from every correlated input.
protocol.aggregation: Point-pooled errors per model; model comparisons are descriptive across eight matched training seeds.
